steps.content: The incredible might of this S-Class Sinner forces you to back up step by step. The threat that the shears pose to your shackles constrains you.

options: It's not time to admit defeat yet.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: It's no use. I've seen this power already. You won't give me any more surprises.
The spikes of red light bursting from your palm flood the whole room, but Adela is even faster. She knocks you to the ground with a heavy blow and holds you down.
The night wind is ice-cold, and the dim light illuminates the hairdresser holding you down.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: A for effort. Are these called shackles? They really are quite powerful... Usually, whatever I sever is completely forgotten. You're the first person to ever regain something I've severed.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Why get these shackles back? A power that condemns you to loneliness, suffocating responsibilities, endless dilemmas, unavoidable battles and an unknown fate...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: It's the saddest thing I've ever encountered. I see that you're sprouting long, long hair again.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Shall I cut it for you? You're such a good person. You deserve a simple, happy life.
You try to push her off, but she doesn't budge, so you give up struggling and try to think of a response as you lie flat on your back.

options: Really? I think it's fine to have hair like that.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Don't I look cool with my bright smile shining through those hairs of worry?
A smile shows on her face.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: You look cool right now, but what about the future?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: You've touched my shears before. You know what those scenes look like. They aren't just illusions.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: That kind of hair grows like madness. You can't get rid of it, nor can you make it stop. It's bound to crush you one day.

options: It's okay. I'll go to dear Adela.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: She's the gentlest hairdresser in the world. She listens to me and understands me. She helps me think of solutions, and makes me soothing black tea.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: When I'm with her, all my worries fade away.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: She can't make all your worries fade away. More often than not, she can only watch from the sidelines. But <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color> can.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Let her cut off everything. What you don't remember won't bother you.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Forget everything and stay here. This is a beautiful place. I'll safeguard your peaceful life forever.
It's not time yet. You can still try to convince her. Just bet on the chance that she really does "care".

options: So I should forget about you too?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I came to catch you, but got pummeled by you. You then extended a helping hand to me at my weakest, and took care of me so tenderly. We went in a full circle, but everything is different now.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If I really do have worrisome hair, then those worries aren't just burdens. They also include many things worth cherishing. I worry because I care. I can't bear to lose them, and I can't bear to lose you either.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: As long as you're still Mad Shears, as long as you're still Adela, I can't bear to let you go.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...Worries worth cherishing...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I've never heard anyone say that before. So many people have confided in me, and they all said they wanted to escape from their worries... Once again, you stand apart from the crowd.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Maybe they feel the same as I do, but say otherwise just to vent their frustrations. After all, people are often blind in their own cause. The world's not black and white, right?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...Perhaps. That's beyond my comprehension.
She looks down slightly.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I don't have any worries, so I don't know... what worries are worth cherishing.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: As you know, all I can see is crazily sprouting hair.
A low roar shakes the ground, and the thick fog begins to surge. The wind becomes a violent storm, lifting her short hair from behind.

Adela constrains your attempts at resistance, her eyes fixed on yours. She raises her hand slowly, dangling those cold, sharp shears above you. The cold gleam of the blades reflects in your eyes. You're ice-cold all over.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: These hairs are heavy and burdensome. I've seen them suffocate and devour people countless times. I've seen and heard too much. I don't want to see you end up like that.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...You're the only one who I don't want to see meeting the same fate.
You've failed to persuade her. She swings her wrist, and the shears strike towards you. But at that moment...
Zing!

A bullet whizzes past the shears. A dazzling searchlight shines in, illuminating the terrace like the sun. Breaking through the thick fog are several FAC-MBCC combat helicopters, accompanied by those you've parted with for too long.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We found them! They are here. Chief!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Dummy, letting someone step on you like a doormat again?!! Get up!!
A uniformed woman stops the two Sinners from rushing to go down. The adjutant has her gun pointed at Adela as she calmly issues commands.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Coordinates confirmed. Turn the anti-Mania devices on to maximum. Stop the fog and prepare to rescue the Chief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Mad Shears... No, <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>! Leave the Chief alone and back off! This is an ultimatum!!!
With everything exposed, Adela's calm expression changes for the first time. In contrast to the huge MBCC search and rescue team behind you, she's all alone.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...How did they penetrate the fog?
You did feel something earlier. Was it from the shackles? Or was it... You look at the little swaying lantern on the helicopter, think for a while, and decide to change the focus point.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: There is a special connection between us. It takes a bit of time, but as long as the shackles are still here, they're sure to find me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: They are my cherished "troubles." I won't let you sever them from me.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...I see... So you said all those things to stall time.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: How clever of you, Mr. Inspector...
steps.female_content: How clever of you, Ms. Inspector...

steps.content: The constraint on you loosens. She seems to suddenly have lost all her strength. You finally claim the victory you deserve. However, after going through so much, you can no longer regard her simply as a hostile target.
On that first night, why did she fight you so fiercely? And after that, why didn't she take back her shears?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: No need. Things are fine the way they are.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: My life is as peaceful as always. I'm content. It should continue like this.

options: That wasn't just for stalling time.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I really meant what I said.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I don't know how "Mad Shears" came about, or what happened in the past to make you so obsessed with "worries." But I'm willing to trust the gentle Adela I know.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I trust that you really want to help others, and that you want to cherish your stable and peaceful life in your own way.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Put down the shears. So long as they control you, you'll never get what you truly want.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: A stable and peaceful life... yes, I do cherish a life like that.
Adela gets up slowly, lowering her shears. Under the strong light, you can't see her expression clearly.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I like the neighbors here. I like the worry-free days I've spent here.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: After wandering for so long, I finally found... such a peaceful place.
An ominous feeling appears. The voices of the townspeople ring out from the thinning fog.

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: The FAC! It's the FAC! We're saved! The fog is about to get dispersed! Mad Shears is at... the hair salon?

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: Isn't that Adela's shop? How is Miss Adela? Why are those people pointing their guns at her?

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: ...No, that's impossible... How can Adela be Mad Shears? Adela, she...
The thick fog is surging slowly, and more and more murmurs pass through it to reach your ears. Under the bright light, the notorious Mad Shears of Eastside has nowhere to hide, and looks a bit dazed.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Hair... So much hair... Everyone is worried again... and this time, it's because of me...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Hehe... This moment would come sooner or later...
Her figure is so frail that it looks like she's going to disappear into the light at any moment.
You're suddenly seized by panic. You have to grab her! Out of instinct, you ignore the danger and struggle up, trying to grab her.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Things aren't hopeless yet! You're just a victim of circumstance who got controlled by Mania. Everyone will understand! I'll... try to bail you out and let you come back here.
You reach out to her, but grab her shears instead. In an instant, a head-splitting headache hits you again. Your vision quivers, blocked by long messy hair once more.
The hair belongs to Adela this time. It has grown to enormous lengths, tangled and heavy.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I haven't experienced this for so long that I almost forgot... this is what <color=#fb9259>worry</color> feels like...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I moved many times before finally finding this place—a little home where I can sleep peacefully, a job that I can excel at, and the opportunity to gain trust and give back. Every problem has its solution.

options: I don't want to take away what you cherish.

steps.content: You want to pull her to your side, but the intense disorientation caused by the shears makes it impossible to do so.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: It's fine. Don't worry about me, Mr. Inspector. No one will get hurt...
steps.female_content: It's fine. Don't worry about me, Miss Inspector. No one will get hurt...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I'm a hairdresser who trims away worries. Dealing with this kind of thing is my forte.
To be the Mad Shears who goes around Eastside doing as she pleased without ever revealing her face, while at the same time being worry-free Adela...
How is that possible? It's not that she's never been discovered, or that she doesn't have any worries, it's just that she knows how to <color=#fb9259>deal with those things</color>.
Under the aim of countless guns, Adela lets go of your hand gently.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Farewell, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Whether it's Adela or Mad Shears... You don't have to worry about me any longer.
You've failed. The hair on the floor ensnares you. Adela takes a step back, clutching the shears in her hand. You hear the alarm go off nearby.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: The M-value is rising! What the... Her power is growing rapidly! Be careful, everyone! It's an S-Class Sinner!!!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ?! Sniper, shoot!!! Stop her!!!
Bullets pierce her shadow, riddling the ground with holes. Dense fog gushes forth, blanketing the entire area once again.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Stop, Adela! Stop...
With a cold flicker, the blade slashes you. Something flashes across your eyes. You're alive, but something in your consciousness has splintered off again.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief!! Argh!
Her shadow flashes by. The helicopters shudder violently, and some of them crash to the ground.
You struggle to crawl over and force yourself into the cabin. Nightingale, the combatants, and even the Sinners... They're all fine, but have lost consciousness.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Adela...

You open your mouth, but forget what you wanted to shout. Your memory is shattered once more. You seem to hear the townspeople's screams in the distance, wave after wave. Soon after, everything falls into silence again. All that is left is the rolling fog.
But you manage to remember something. You reach into your pocket and feel a string of <color=#fb9259>keys</color>.

...To find her, you must go to <color=#fb9259>that place</color>. There's still a chance. She's not without worries. She knows what it's like to suffer from them, and what it's like to cherish them. She can't bear to part with them, either.
You must catch her... while you still can.
